component.name: FonteItem
component.script: function init() as void m.fundo = m.top.findNode("fundo") m.titulo = m.top.findNode("titulo") m.valor = m.top.findNode("valor") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onConteudo") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFoco") m.top.observeField("listHasFocus", "onFoco") end function function onConteudo() as void c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.titulo.text = c.title m.valor.text = c.description end function function onFoco() as void f = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.listHasFocus m.fundo.visible = f if f then m.titulo.color = "#0b0e14" : m.valor.color = "#334155" else m.titulo.color = "#FFFFFF" : m.valor.color = "#A8B4C0" end if end function
